title: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Orphaned when a monster attack kills her parents, Alicia spends three miserable years mistreated in an orphanage, runs away, and is attacked by a woman who wants to take her place as the heroine of an 'otome game'; Alicia absorbs part of the woman's memories and becomes a calculating young fighter (J-Novel Club blurb). Rejecting the heroine role, she takes the adventurer name Aria and grows into the 'Ash-crowned Princess of Slaughter', later escorting a 'villainess' into noble intrigues (MU description). Ongoing manga of a web novel.
life_message: You are yourself, not a role written for you; strength and self-reliance let you choose your own fate.
